account_id.title: Account Id
account_id.description: Person Account Id from the session.

active_rental_records.title: Active Rental Records
active_rental_records.description: Occupied apartment records for this session.

apartment_choices.title: Apartment Choices
apartment_choices.description: Names of the occupied apartments, one per line.

contact_id.title: Contact Id
contact_id.description: Messaging session contact. Empty when the session has no contact.

default_apartment_id.title: Default Apartment Id
default_apartment_id.description: The one occupied apartment Id, or the Id of the single apartment name found in the message. Empty when the resident must still choose.

is_active_tenant.title: Is Active Tenant
is_active_tenant.description: True when that account has at least one occupied apartment.

is_valid_user.title: Is Valid User
is_valid_user.description: True when the session has an end-user account.

person_email.title: Person Email
person_email.description: PersonEmail on the session account. The model must not change it.

result.title: Result
result.description: Number of occupied apartments. 0 when there is no active rental.
